name: PM-KISAN
desc: ₹6,000/year direct income support paid in 3 installments to eligible farmer families.
eligibility: Cultivable landholding as per state land records
Excludes institutional landholders and income-tax payers
steps: Visit pmkisan.gov.in and select 'New Farmer Registration'
Enter Aadhaar number and basic details
Fill land and bank details as per records
Submit and note your registration ID for tracking

name: PMFBY (Crop Insurance)
desc: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana — low-premium insurance covering crop loss from natural calamities, pests, and disease.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
Both loanee and non-loanee farmers eligible
steps: Apply through your bank, CSC center, or the PMFBY portal
Choose your crop and season (Kharif/Rabi)
Pay the farmer share of premium (as low as 1.5-2%)
Insurer settles claims based on yield/loss assessment

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
desc: Short-term credit at low interest for crop, working capital, and allied agricultural needs.
eligibility: Farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and self-help groups
Fisheries and animal husbandry farmers also eligible
steps: Visit nearest bank branch or apply online via bank portal
Fill KCC application with land and crop details
Bank assesses and sanctions credit limit
Receive KCC card/passbook for withdrawals

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
desc: Free soil testing every 2 years with crop-wise nutrient and fertilizer recommendations.
documents: Aadhaar card (for registration at some centers)
steps: Contact your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra or agriculture office
Submit a soil sample from your field
Receive Soil Health Card with recommendations within weeks

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
desc: Subsidy support for drip and sprinkler irrigation systems to improve water-use efficiency.
eligibility: All categories of farmers, with higher subsidy for small/marginal and SC/ST farmers
documents: Quotation from approved irrigation equipment dealer
steps: Apply through state agriculture/horticulture department portal
Get field verification done
Purchase approved equipment from empanelled dealer
Subsidy credited after installation verification

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
desc: Online trading platform connecting farmers to buyers across mandis for better price discovery.
eligibility: Farmers registered with a participating APMC mandi
steps: Register at your nearest e-NAM enabled mandi
Get produce quality-assayed on arrival
List produce for e-auction
Receive payment directly to bank account
